title: The passive with ser and with se

sections.content: You know the *se* passive (*se publican las leyes*) from B1 Unit 6. This lesson adds the passive with *ser* + past participle: *La ley fue aprobada por el Parlamento*. The participle agrees with the subject (*la ley fue aprobada*, *las leyes fueron aprobadas*) and *por* names who does the action. Use the *se* passive when the actor is general or unimportant, and *ser* + participle when you want to name the actor or stress the result.

items.spanish: Se publican nuevas leyes cada año.
items.english: New laws are published every year.

items.spanish: Se ofrecen servicios públicos en la ciudad.
items.english: Public services are offered in the city.

items.spanish: La ley fue aprobada por el Parlamento.
items.english: The law was approved by Parliament.

items.spanish: Se toman decisiones importantes en estas reuniones.
items.english: Important decisions are made in these meetings.

items.spanish: Las leyes fueron aprobadas por el Parlamento.
items.english: The laws were approved by Parliament.

sections.content: With *ser* + participle the participle agrees with the subject: *aprobada* after *la ley*, *aprobadas* after *las leyes*. With *se* the verb agrees with the thing: *se publican leyes*.
